topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well, well, what do we have here? Your college essay, yep, the very same one you sweated bullets over, turns out it's gone and made the rounds. They're using it as a shining example, a benchmark for the freshmen to follow. That's not a common occurrence, you know. Takes some serious writing to pull that off. Means you’ve got a knack for it, a real talent that’s hard to ignore. So, maybe you didn’t nab the spot just yet, but you’ve got their attention. And attention is the start of something big. Keep pushing, because the world could use a little more of what you’ve got cooking in that noggin of yours.
